decisions.statement: A credential missing from the environment is refused as something said wrongly.
A credential is never carried into the answer or into a log.
The answer carries the id the carrier gave the message.
No message is taken back once that message is sent.
A message the carrier took is named as soon as the carrier answers that it took it.
A refusal after that names the message the carrier took.
A carrier that refused the message leaves the refusal naming no message taken.
The reaching of the carrier is handed in.
The number sent from is the toll-free number unless another number is said.
A body read from a file has no closing line ending.
A carrier answering anything but OK is operational rather than a refusal.
Nothing here checks that the number is one anybody enrolled.
The carrier reached is the live API unless another is said.
A call saying neither a body nor a file to read one from is refused.

definition: the command putting one text message out over the toll-free number
